name: week
title: Records desk: this week
subtitle: Internal review. Fictional when using demo data.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select name,owner,kind,reason from attention_queue order by kind,name

sections.title: Retention decisions
sections.sql: select name,owner,retention_end,active_holds,decision from retention_queue order by name
sections.note: Eligibility is for human review. No destruction is authorised.

sections.title: Original coverage
sections.sql: select name,cabinet,owner,current_version,bytes,active_holds from record_register order by cabinet,name

sections.title: Identical originals
sections.sql: select sha256,count(distinct record_id) as records from versions group by sha256 having count(distinct record_id)>1

sections.title: Current reviews
sections.sql: select name,record_class,review_current,last_outcome,last_review,next_review from record_register order by name

sections.title: Recorded controls
sections.sql: select name,actor,evidence,next_review from controls order by created_at desc
